preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the graph is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and the maximum possible number of edges, which is either 10^5 or N * (N - 1) / 2, whichever is greater.
The integer P is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each node number A and B in the edge list is between 1 and N, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of critical links in the graph.
